The primary goal is to estimate the proportion of proteasome-spliced peptides (PSPs) in the HLA-I ligandome. There is no experimental perturbation or differential treatment applied in the proteomics analysis itself; rather, it is a characterization of the ligandome across different cell types/tissues (Melanoma, B cell, Fibroblast). Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.
